records.report:
FINDINGS:

Prominent bone contusions in the medial aspect of the medial femoral condyle, lateral tibial plateau, posterior aspect of the medial tibial plateau, proximal metaphyseal region of the tibia, fibular head and anteroinferior aspect of the lateral femoral condyle. Suspected microtrabecular impaction fracture at the posterior aspect of the lateral tibial plateau.

Fluid:
Moderate joint effusion. No popliteal cyst.

Medial compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament, cartilage):
Normal.

Lateral compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament complex, cartilage):
Normal.

Intercondylar compartment (anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments):
Complete full-thickness tear at the proximal third of the anterior cruciate ligament, the tibial insertion is unremarkable. The posterior cruciate ligament is normal.

Anterior compartment (extensor mechanism, cartilage, Hoffa's fat pad):
Mild signal abnormality at the medial facet of the patella without full-thickness chondral fissures or subchondral reactive changes.
The extensor mechanism is unremarkable.
Small amount of fluid in the topography of the infrapatellar ligament.

Muscles and neurovascular structures:
Edema of the popliteus muscle, likely traumatic in nature/sprain.

Other findings:
None

CONCLUSION:

1.Prominent bone contusions at the medial femoral condyle, lateral tibial plateau, posterior aspect of the medial tibial plateau, proximal metaphyseal region of the tibia, fibular head and anteroinferior aspect of the lateral femoral condyle. Suspected microtrabecular impaction fracture at the posterior aspect of the lateral tibial plateau. Moderate joint effusion.
2.Complete full-thickness tear at the proximal third of the anterior cruciate ligament.

records.report:
Findings:  The clinically palpable lump along the medial aspect of the knee is seen to represent a well-circumscribed intra-articular structure measuring 5 x 19 x 19 mm. It is of intermediate low signal intensity on PD fat sat and intermediate low signal intensity on T1 but no associated enhancement post contrast administration. The lesion looks like a loose intra-articular body.  
There is no significant knee effusion. Undersurface fraying of the body of medial meniscus is noted. Normal lateral meniscus.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  Normal tibiofemoral and patellofemoral articular cartilage. No evidence of osteochondral defect identified to suggest as origin of the described loose intra-articular body.  
Conclusion: 19 mm loose intra-articular body within the anteromedial recess of the knee. Its nature is uncertain. Mild fraying of the undersurface of the medial meniscal body also noted.

records.report: МР находка: Костите, формиращи лявата колянна става са с нормална форма и интензитет на сигнала. Няма данни за ставен излив. Ставният хрущял на тибията и фемура е неизтънен и със запазена конгруентност. Не се изобразяват патологични лезии в менискусите. Нормално изобразяване на предните и задните им рога. Предната кръстна връзка е с белези на руптура на влакна. Връзката е задебелена и с повишен сигнален интензитет. Нормално изобразяване на задната кръстна връзка. Колатерални лигаменти – б.о.  Патела – б.о. Ретинакулуми на пателата и хрущял на пателата с нормален МР образ. Сухожилие на м квадрицепс феморис и лигамент на пателата – б.о. Наличие на течност около мускуло-сухожилното съчленение на медиалната глава на м. гастрокнемиус. Не се виждат други промени в меките тъкани на дясното коляно. Заключение: МР данни за частична руптура на предна кръстна връзка на лявата колянна става.
